title: Game-Ware Vol. 5
overview:
- Pipitto Boy no Daibouken 5: Pipitto Boy's tearful final episode! Skillfully work the rope and defeat the enemies!
- Edison: Edison's first - includes a mini polygon fighting game!
- Oniisan: A story of love that bloomed like a single flower in a Western-style restaurant! A slightly bittersweet digital comic!
- RPG Club (Goldfish Princess's Sherbet): An RPG made by everyone. This time it's packed with ideas from users!
- World Conquest Inc.: A simulation game finally arrives. Raise monsters and conquer the world!!
- Toru Toru Marble: Uses your brain a little. Aim to clear every stage the way you'd draw a figure in one stroke!
- Fun Blackjack: You can win presents yet again. A fun mini-game.
- Game Demo Corner: Try out masterpiece Sega Saturn games.
- Barbara Konomi's Numerology: Words of wisdom. Put them to use in your life.
- Virtua Fighter 3 & Sakura Taisen strategy video previews: With these, you too can be a super player!
- Girl's Collection in Shinjuku Joypolis: Packed with attraction info and cute girls!
- Information: Enjoy premiere footage of movies and videos!
- Digital Gallery: Videos submitted by users. This time's Captain Japan is...
